title: Skincare Gift for Mother: Gentle Picks for Mature Skin
ex: How to choose a skincare gift for your mother in her 40s, 50s or beyond: gentle, moisturising picks, what to avoid, and how to present it so she uses it.
rt: Skincare Gift for Mother: Gentle Picks for Mom | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare gift for mother: gentle, moisturising picks for mature skin in her 40s and 50s, what to avoid, a budget table and tips for Diwali and Mother's Day.
quick: Give one rich, gentle cream that fits a single step of her day. Mature skin usually feels drier and reacts more to harsh products, so choose moisture over strong actives, write simple instructions in large print and do the first application with her.
facts: Mature skin often feels drier and more reactive
One step is more likely to become a habit
Avoid fairness creams and unguided retinol or peels
Pigment patches may be melasma: see a dermatologist
